fields.name: PgServiceBuilderExtensions.AddPgServices
fields.contract:
IServiceCollection AddPgServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration config)

Calling PgServiceBuilderExtensions.AddPgServices establishes the PostgreSQL service-registration set on the supplied collection: it assigns the query statement extension "psql"; binds PgGlobalPropertiesOptions from the "PgGlobalSettings" section; binds PgDbConnectionOptions and PgShardConnectionOptions from the supplied configuration; registers PgDatabases and PgShardSets as singleton services; and returns the same IServiceCollection.
